spec.title: Task View Filtering & Search
spec.context: Users with many tasks must scroll through columns to find specific items. This becomes increasingly painful as task count grows, slowing down navigation and task discovery. Power users need a way to quickly locate tasks by ID or title.

scope.in-scope: - Add "Find Task" command accessible from KANBAN TASKS header - QuickPick UI showing all tasks with fuzzy search - Search across task ID and title - Reveal selected task in TreeView (expand column, highlight task) - Keyboard shortcut for quick access
scope.out-of-scope: - Inline filter input within TreeView panel (not supported by VSCode API) - WebviewView implementation - Filtering by status, priority, or labels (future enhancement) - Persistent filter state

spec.requirements: - FR1: The system shall register a "kanban.findTask" command with search icon in view header - FR2: The system shall display a QuickPick populated with all tasks from all columns - FR3: The system shall show task ID and title as QuickPickItem label (e.g., "001: Add settings panel") - FR4: The system shall show task labels as QuickPickItem description (e.g., "#feature #bug") - FR5: The system shall show task status and priority as QuickPickItem detail - FR6: The system shall enable matchOnDescription and matchOnDetail for fuzzy search - FR7: The system shall reveal the selected task in the TreeView when user confirms selection - FR8: The system shall expand the parent StatusGroupItem to show the selected task

files.file: Register kanban.findTask command, implement QuickPick logic, call TreeView.reveal()
Export TaskItem class (already exported), ensure TreeView reveal works with TaskItem
Add kanban.findTask command contribution and view/title menu entry with search icon

patterns.pattern: Existing pattern for Discovery, Create, Refresh buttons in view/title menu. Reference: apps/vscode/package.json:103-118
Commands registered via vscode.commands.registerCommand with args handling. Reference: apps/vscode/src/extension.ts:232-238
VSCode TreeView API supports reveal(element, options) to expand and select items. Reference: VSCode API - TreeView.reveal()
Use showQuickPick with matchOnDescription: true and matchOnDetail: true for fuzzy search. Reference: VSCode API - QuickPickOptions

research.product: - vscode/kanban-view: TreeView showing tasks grouped by status columns. Header includes Discovery, Create, Refresh buttons. Tasks display ID, title, priority, labels.
research.engineering: - systems/vscode-extension: Three-layer architecture (Orchestrator, Capabilities, Computers). TreeDataProvider pattern with custom TreeItem classes.
research.codebase: - TaskItem class already exported from tasks-view.capability.ts - TreeView created at extension.ts:203 with treeDataProvider - Header actions registered via package.json view/title menu - loadAllTasks() function available in extension.ts for getting all tasks
research.pitfalls: - VSCode TreeView API does not support inline filter/search (GitHub issue #50062 open since 2018) - WebviewView would be required for inline search box - rejected per user preference - QuickPick is the standard VSCode pattern for search/navigation (Cmd+P, Cmd+Shift+O)

spec.constraints: - Must use native VSCode APIs only (no external dependencies) - Must follow existing header action pattern for consistency - TreeView.reveal() requires the TreeView instance to be accessible from command handler - QuickPickItems must map back to TaskItems for reveal to work

dependencies.external: None - uses native VSCode QuickPick and TreeView APIs
dependencies.internal: - Existing loadAllTasks() function for populating QuickPick - Existing TaskItem class for TreeView reveal - Existing treeView instance for reveal() calls
